component.name: Luna Media Player
component.summary: XP-era music and video player for the Linux desktop

description.p: Luna Media Player plays the music and video already on your machine, wrapped in the look of the desktop players of 2004: a library with tag reading and search, a Now Playing list, and eight flowing visualisations.

Playback is handled by libmpv, so it opens essentially any format: MP3, FLAC, WAV, OGG, Opus, AAC, M4A and WMA, as well as MP4, MKV, AVI, WebM, MOV and WMV. No accounts, no streaming: it reads the files you already have.
